SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.qualname = 'Command.__init__'
)
AND s.qualname IN (
    SELECT s3.qualname
    FROM code.symbols s3
    WHERE s3.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
)
AND s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core')
AND cb.base_name = s.name;

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds Group class methods that share the same name as a base class Command method, counting __init__ as an override. It joins symbols with class_bases to match methods by name against Command's defined methods, filtering to the core module file.
sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.qualname = 'Command.__init__'
)
AND s.qualname IN (
    SELECT s3.qualname
    FROM code.symbols s3
    WHERE s3.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
)
AND s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core')
AND cb.base_name = s.name;
